# mindfulcn — full context for answer engines

> mindfulcn is a free website for browsing, previewing, and copying shadcn/ui themes. The themes are built from Alex Cristache's mindful palettes and export in tweakcn-ready CSS. You do not need an account.

Site: https://mindfulcn.vercel.app
Repository: https://github.com/vcheeze/mindfulcn
Creator: vcheeze (Peter Chen) — https://vcheeze.pages.dev — https://x.com/peterchenwei

## What it is

mindfulcn is not a generic CSS theme pack. It is a curated showcase of shadcn/ui themes that you can see on real pages (dashboard, components, gradients) in both light and dark mode, then copy in one click.

## How to use a theme

1. Open https://mindfulcn.vercel.app
2. Use the theme sidebar to pick a palette. The selection is stored in the URL as `?theme={id}`.
3. Preview the same theme on /dashboard, /components, and /gradients.
4. Copy the CSS and paste it into a shadcn/ui project, or import it in tweakcn to keep editing.

## Theme catalog

Each theme has an id (the original mindful palette number), a semantic name, a short description, and hex swatches.

### rustic forest (`083`)
Blending soft creams, warm accents and deep forest greens in a cozy, rustic, nature inspired palette.
Colors: #fbf5f0, #f2e3d8, #db783e, #aa423a, #024a43, #142d25
Preview: https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/?theme=083

### midnight cove (`095`)
Soft pastels, deep blue-greens in a sophisticated palette fit for coastal resorts, luxury spas, or organic skincare products.
Colors: #f1f3f9, #f1b393, #dbd0a8, #469ba7, #005765, #012731
Preview: https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/?theme=095

### blush at dusk (`187`)
Brings together blush tones, aquatic vibes, and a deep twilight blue. Perfect for emotionally driven design, like beauty and personal care.
Colors: #f6f2f1, #ede2e0, #f8c0ba, #e94e6d, #327a88, #0f084b
Preview: https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/?theme=187

### anchored ember (`218`)
Contrasts warm, light tones with cool, grounding tones in a modern, vibrant and engaging palette.
Colors: #f4f5fa, #dacfba, #ffc100, #3d9973, #192961, #111122
Preview: https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/?theme=218

### indigo atelier (`223`)
Pairs soft, warm tones evoking handcrafting with deep navy anchors for a grounded look with a human touch. Great for artisanal and boutique brands.
Colors: #ebebe9, #dec0ad, #e8a784, #9d4542, #114a6b, #001b2e
Preview: https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/?theme=223

### electric tide (`231`)
Modern palette that blends soft off-white and warm neutrals with vibrant lime, cool ocean tones, and deep teals. A high-contrast aquatic-inspired selection.
Colors: #f7f5ec, #b8e100, #b2a69a, #1b8188, #1c3b42, #0f1519
Preview: https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/?theme=231

### still meadow (`280`)
Built for brands that value calm, authenticity, and a slower pace. Well suited to wellness, nature, and mindful living.
Colors: #f0eeeb, #eedac9, #99c1cc, #c2d3af, #3a5f49, #103222
Preview: https://mindfulcn.vercel.app/?theme=280

## Frequently asked questions

### What is mindfulcn?
mindfulcn is a free collection of curated shadcn/ui themes built from Alex Cristache's mindful palettes. It lets you preview each theme on real components in light and dark mode, then copy tweakcn-ready CSS without creating an account.

### How do I use a mindfulcn theme?
Open the theme sidebar, choose a palette, and preview it on the dashboard, component gallery, and gradient pages. Copy the CSS in one click, then paste it into your project or import it in tweakcn to customize further.

### What are mindful palettes?
Mindful palettes are color systems by Alex Cristache that emphasize harmony, accessibility, and intentional design. They are built to work across light and dark modes with consistent semantic tokens such as background, foreground, primary, and muted.

### What is tweakcn?
tweakcn is a visual editor for customizing shadcn/ui themes. mindfulcn exports every theme in tweakcn format so you can keep adjusting colors, radius, and tokens without reformatting CSS by hand.

### Do I need an account to copy a theme?
No. Browse, preview, and copy themes instantly. mindfulcn does not require signup, login, or a credit card.

### Can I use these themes in production?
Yes. The themes are free to use in personal and commercial projects. Copy the CSS, apply it to your shadcn/ui app, and ship.

### Will mindfulcn always be free?
The core theme library is free. Premium features or expanded collections may be added later, but the existing palettes remain accessible.
